title: Who will win the women's 49kg weightlifting gold medal at the 2026 Asian Games?
background: Weightlifting competitors are ranked by their combined results in the snatch and clean and jerk.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Asian Games results, corroborated by contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the athlete awarded the gold medal in the women's 49kg weightlifting competition at the 2026 Asian Games.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The athlete's full name.

title: Which activist detained in Tunisia's Global Sumud Flotilla fundraising case will suspend his hunger strike between September 12 and September 27, 2026?
background: Four activists have been detained since March in a Tunisian investigation into alleged financial irregularities involving fundraising for the Global Sumud Flotilla, an international campaign seeking to deliver aid to Gaza. Hunger strikes are being used to protest their continued detention.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera identifying which of the four detained activists has suspended his hunger strike.
  • Resolution Conditions: The suspension must have occurred between September 12 and September 27, 2026, inclusive. Appeals to suspend the strike or statements of future intention do not count.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The activist's full name.

title: Which country will become the 75th signatory of the Artemis Accords by September 27, 2026?
background: The Artemis Accords establish principles for international cooperation in civil space exploration.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official announcements from NASA or the U.S. Department of State, or contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the country that becomes the 75th signatory of the Artemis Accords on or before September 27, 2026. A completed signing is required; an expression of interest or an intention to sign does not qualify. A signing after that deadline does not count.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's name.

title: Who will win the men's 200-metre breaststroke gold medal at the 2026 Asian Games?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Asian Games swimming results or contemporaneous news reporting identifying the gold medalist in the men's 200-metre breaststroke at the 2026 Asian Games.
  • Resolution: Resolve when the final result of this event is publicly confirmed.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The gold medalist's full name.

title: Who will score the match-winning goal in Portugal's opening fixture of the 2026–27 UEFA Nations League?
background: Portugal enter the competition as defending champions. This question concerns their senior men's team's first league-phase match.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: UEFA's official match report or contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera Sport.
  • Resolution: Resolve after Portugal's opening league-phase match in September 2026. The match-winning goal is the winning team's goal that brings its total to one more than the losing team's final total. The answer is the player officially credited with that goal, regardless of which team wins.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The goalscorer's full name. If the match ends in a draw, return “No winning scorer”.

title: Which federal appeals court will next rule that state gambling laws apply to Kalshi’s event contracts?
background: Kalshi offers contracts tied to the outcomes of real-world events. Federal appeals courts have reached conflicting conclusions about whether these contracts are subject to state gambling laws.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Published federal appeals court decisions, corroborated by reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution Condition: Identify the first federal circuit court of appeals to issue a ruling after August 31, 2026, holding that states may apply their gambling laws to Kalshi’s event contracts.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the federal appeals circuit.

title: Which U.S. state will be the first to settle its lawsuit against TikTok over youth-safety claims?
background: TikTok faces lawsuits from U.S. states alleging that its platform harms young users and misleads consumers about its safety protections.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official announcements from state attorneys general, supported by reliable contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the U.S. state that reaches the first publicly announced settlement agreement with TikTok resolving a state lawsuit over youth safety and allegedly misleading safety claims. The agreement must be announced by September 30, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the U.S. state.

title: Which national team will win the England–Spain UEFA Nations League match at Wembley on September 19, 2026?
background: The UEFA Nations League is a competition for European national teams.
resolution_criteria:

  • Resolution: Resolve to the national team declared the winner at full time in the September 19, 2026 fixture. If the match finishes level, resolve as Draw.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's commonly used English name, or Draw.

title: Who will win the 2026 Formula One Azerbaijan Grand Prix?

resolution_criteria:

  • Resolution: Resolve to the driver classified as the race winner when the official race result is published.

title: Which Indian cricketer will publicly say by September 20, 2026, that the 2027 men's ODI World Cup will be his last for India?
background: The men's ODI World Cup is the global championship for cricket's 50-over international format.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: A public statement or interview by the player, quoted by a reputable news organization.
  • Resolution Condition: Identify the Indian cricketer who publicly declares between September 1 and September 20, 2026, inclusive, that the 2027 men's ODI World Cup will be his final World Cup representing India. The question resolves when the declaration is made, not when the player subsequently retires.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The player's full name.

title: Which city or region will the DOSB choose in 2026 to represent Germany in bidding for the 2036, 2040 or 2044 Summer Olympics?
background: The DOSB is Germany's national Olympic committee. Its domestic candidate selection is separate from the International Olympic Committee's eventual decision on which country will host the Games.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The DOSB's official selection announcement, as confirmed by reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the city or region officially selected during 2026 to represent Germany in bidding for the 2036, 2040 or 2044 Summer Olympics. This concerns Germany's domestic candidate selection, not the eventual international host selection.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the selected city or region.

title: Which U.S. state will ask a court to halt further development of ChatGPT over safety concerns in September 2026?
background: ChatGPT is OpenAI’s conversational AI service. State authorities can seek court orders restricting products they allege pose risks to consumers.

  • Qualifying Event: During September 2026, a U.S. state formally asks a court to stop OpenAI from further developing ChatGPT until safety safeguards are established. The request itself resolves the question; the court need not grant it.

title: Which country will end China's gold-medal bid in men's football at the 2026 Asian Games?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official 2026 Asian Games men's football results, corroborated by reliable match reporting.
